title: Efficacy of Tecovirimat for the Treatment of Mpox Virus Infection in Humans: Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials.
abstract: Tecovirimat has been widely used for the treatment of mpox despite limited evidence supporting its efficacy. We conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials (RCTs) to evaluate the efficacy and safety of tecovirimat for this purpose. PubMed, Embase, and the Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials were searched from inception to June 5, 2026 for RCTs comparing tecovirimat with placebo or standard care in patients with laboratory-confirmed mpox. Primary outcomes were time to clinical resolution of skin lesions, clinical resolution by day 28-29, and 28-day all-cause mortality. Hazard ratios (HRs) and risk ratios (RRs) were pooled using random-effects models with restricted maximum likelihood estimation and Hartung-Knapp-Sidik-Jonkman adjustment. Risk of bias was assessed using RoB 2 and certainty of evidence using GRADE. Two low-risk-of-bias RCTs involving 941 participants were included. Tecovirimat did not shorten the time to clinical resolution of skin lesions compared with placebo (HR 1.10, 95% CI 0.52-2.31, GRADE: moderate) or increase the lesion resolution by day 28-29 (RR 1.00, 95% CI 0.92-1.08, GRADE: high). No statistical heterogeneity was observed (I 2 = 0% for both outcomes). Mortality at day 28 was rare in both trials, precluding meta-analysis. Virological clearance, pain-related outcomes, and serious adverse events were also comparable between treatment groups. In conclusion, current randomized evidence does not support routine tecovirimat use to accelerate clinical recovery or improve mortality rates in patients with mpox, while further evidence is needed to determine whether selected high-risk populations may benefit from antiviral therapy.

title: Mpox and sexually transmitted infections: syndemic drivers of transmission and disease outcomes-A Narrative Review
abstract: The worldwide outbreak of mpox (formerly monkeypox) in 2022 emerged as a public health emergency posing greater threat to persons with sexually transmitted infections (STIs). This outbreak featured an increase in overlap between mpox and STIs reflecting evolving transmission dynamics in sexual networks. Epidemiological data reveal that STIs such as human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), Chlamydia trachomatis , herpes simplex virus, syphilis have been frequently associated with mpox infection highlighting the role of sexual contact in its transmission. A narrative review was conducted using PubMed and Google Scholar to identify relevant literature published between 2008 and 2026, focusing on mpox, STIs, co-infections, and pregnancy outcomes. Evidence suggests that biological, behavioural and structural factors may interact to influence mpox transmission and clinical outcomes. abstract_zh: 2022 年全球爆发的 猴痘(原猴痘)暴发 成为突发公共卫生事件,对性传播感染 (STI) 患者构成更大威胁。该 暴发 的特点是 猴痘 和 STI 之间的重叠增加,反映了性网络中不断变化的 传播 动态。流行病学数据显示,人类免疫缺陷病毒(HIV)、沙眼衣原体、单纯疱疹病毒、梅毒等性传播感染经常与 猴痘 感染相关,这凸显了性接触在 猴痘 感染中的作用。使用 PubMed 和 Google Scholar 进行叙述性回顾,以确定 2008 年至 2026 年期间发表的相关文献,重点关注 猴痘、性传播感染、合并感染和妊娠结局。有证据表明,生物、行为和结构因素可能相互作用,影响 猴痘 传播 和临床结果。STI 合并感染可能与粘膜侵袭和免疫调节有关,可能影响疾病进展,但直接的机制证据仍然有限。尽管 猴痘 感染主要影响同性恋、双性恋和其他男男性行为者 (GBMSM),但其在女性中尤其是怀孕期间的严重程度引起了对垂直 传播 以及孕产妇和新生儿并发症的担忧。本综述重点介绍了 猴痘-STI 合并感染的当前证据,并应用流行病框架来解释它们在生物、行为和结构背景下的共存。虽然这个观点提供了对 传播 模式的理解,但需要进一步研究来确定这些相互作用的程度。认识到这些因素对于筛查、早期 诊断 和减轻未来 暴发 和 猴痘 影响的管理策略非常重要。摘要:这篇关于 猴痘 和 STI 合并感染的叙述性综述探讨了流行病相互作用、猴痘 动态以及对疾病结果和公共卫生管理的影响

title: Epidemiological and sociodemographic profile of Mpox in Brazilian Amazon: a cross-sectional study
abstract: BACKGROUND: The Mpox outbreak was characterized by viral transmission within sexual networks and atypical clinical presentations, requiring regional epidemiological evaluations. This study aimed to describe the sociodemographic profile, temporal notification trends, and clinical characteristics of suspected and confirmed Mpox cases in Pará, Brazilian Amazon (2022-2025). MATERIALS AND METHODS: Observational, cross-sectional, and analytical study based on the Notifiable Diseases Information System (SINAN) between March 2022 and December 2025, adhering to STROBE guidelines. The sample (N = 296) was stratified into confirmed Mpox cases (G1; n = 86) and ruled-out cases (G2; n = 210). Associations were evaluated using Pearson's Chi-square test (for expected cell counts ≥ 5) or Fisher's exact test (for expected counts < 5), with significance set at p < 0.05 in SPSS v.26.0. RESULTS: In G1, infection was concentrated among men (97.7%), cisgender men (96.5%), adults aged 19 to 59 years (98.8%), residents of Belém (76.7%), individuals with tertiary education (53.5%), and those reporting homosexual (73.3%) or bisexual (12.8%) orientation (p < 0.001). Clinically, fever (81.4%; p < 0.001) and localized genital lesions (43.0% in G1 vs. 6.2% in G2; p < 0.001) were the primary presentations. Intimate sexual contact was the primary probable exposure pathway (65.1%; p < 0.001). A high proportion of HIV coinfection was observed in G1 (54.7%), with complete reporting overlap with immunosuppression status, alongside 23.3% presenting an active STI at notification (p < 0.001), predominantly active syphilis (16.3%). Clinical management was predominantly outpatient (7.0% hospitalization rate; p = 0.261), with a 96.5% cure rate among valid confirmed cases. No Mpox-attributed deaths occurred among confirmed cases, though all-cause mortality in G1 was 2.3% (n = 2). CONCLUSION: Mpox cases in Pará were concentrated in the state capital, associated with intimate sexual contact networks among young adults, and characterized by high coinfection frequencies with HIV and syphilis.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study was needed to understand the epidemiological and sociodemographic profile of Mpox in the Brazilian Amazon, as the outbreak showed viral transmission within sexual networks and atypical clinical presentations. The research aimed to characterize the demographic and clinical features of Mpox cases in this region.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This cross-sectional study used data from the Notifiable Diseases Information System (SINAN) between March 2022 and December 2025. The sample included 296 cases, divided into confirmed Mpox cases (G1; n = 86) and ruled-out cases (G2; n = 210).
analysis.methods: The study was observational and analytical, following STROBE guidelines. Associations were evaluated using statistical tests such as Pearson's Chi-square test and Fisher's exact test, with significance set at p < 0.05 in SPSS v.26.0.
analysis.main_results: In confirmed Mpox cases (G1), infection was concentrated among men (97.7%), adults aged 19 to 59 years (98.8%), residents of Belém (76.7%), individuals with tertiary education (53.5%), and those reporting homosexual (73.3%) or bisexual (12.8%) orientation. A high proportion of HIV coinfection was observed in G1 (54.7%), with 23.3% presenting an active STI at notification, predominantly syphilis (16.3%). Clinical management was predominantly outpatient, with a 7.0% hospitalization rate and a 96.5% cure rate among valid confirmed cases.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that Mpox cases in Pará were concentrated in the state capital and associated with intimate sexual contact networks among young adults. They noted the high coinfection frequencies with HIV and syphilis, highlighting a novel association between Mpox and these conditions in this population.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform targeted surveillance and prevention strategies in the Brazilian Amazon, particularly focusing on high-risk groups such as men who have sex with men and individuals with HIV. They also emphasize the need for integrated approaches to address co-occurring STIs.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on a cross-sectional design, which limits causal inference. The sample size is relatively small, and the data are sourced from a notification system, which may introduce reporting biases. The evidence is moderate in strength due to these limitations.

analysis.summary_en: This cross-sectional study analyzed Mpox cases in the Brazilian Amazon from 2022 to 2025, focusing on sociodemographic and clinical profiles. The study found that Mpox was concentrated among men, particularly those in Belém, aged 19 to 59, with tertiary education, and reporting homosexual or bisexual orientation. Fever and localized genital lesions were the primary clinical presentations, with intimate sexual contact as the main exposure pathway. A high proportion of HIV coinfection and active STIs, especially syphilis, was observed. Clinical management was mostly outpatient, with a high cure rate. The authors interpreted these findings as highlighting the role of sexual networks and co-occurring STIs in Mpox transmission. The study's moderate evidence strength is due to its observational design and reliance on notification data, which may introduce biases.

title_zh: 巴西亚马逊 猴痘 的流行病学和社会人口学概况:一项横断面研究
source_body_en: BACKGROUND: The Mpox outbreak was characterized by viral transmission within sexual networks and atypical clinical presentations, requiring regional epidemiological evaluations. This study aimed to describe the sociodemographic profile, temporal notification trends, and clinical characteristics of suspected and confirmed Mpox cases in Pará, Brazilian Amazon (2022-2025). MATERIALS AND METHODS: Observational, cross-sectional, and analytical study based on the Notifiable Diseases Information System (SINAN) between March 2022 and December 2025, adhering to STROBE guidelines. The sample (N = 296) was stratified into confirmed Mpox cases (G1; n = 86) and ruled-out cases (G2; n = 210). Associations were evaluated using Pearson's Chi-square test (for expected cell counts ≥ 5) or Fisher's exact test (for expected counts < 5), with significance set at p < 0.05 in SPSS v.26.0. RESULTS: In G1, infection was concentrated among men (97.7%), cisgender men (96.5%), adults aged 19 to 59 years (98.8%), residents of Belém (76.7%), individuals with tertiary education (53.5%), and those reporting homosexual (73.3%) or bisexual (12.8%) orientation (p < 0.001). Clinically, fever (81.4%; p < 0.001) and localized genital lesions (43.0% in G1 vs. 6.2% in G2; p < 0.001) were the primary presentations. Intimate sexual contact was the primary probable exposure pathway (65.1%; p < 0.001). A high proportion of HIV coinfection was observed in G1 (54.7%), with complete reporting overlap with immunosuppression status, alongside 23.3% presenting an active STI at notification (p < 0.001), predominantly active syphilis (16.3%). Clinical management was predominantly outpatient (7.0% hospitalization rate; p = 0.261), with a 96.5% cure rate among valid confirmed cases. No Mpox-attributed deaths occurred among confirmed cases, though all-cause mortality in G1 was 2.3% (n = 2). CONCLUSION: Mpox cases in Pará were concentrated in the state capital, associated with intimate sexual contact networks among young adults, and characterized by high coinfection frequencies with HIV and syphilis.
abstract_zh: 背景:猴痘 暴发 的特点是性网络内的病毒 传播 和非典型的临床表现,需要区域流行病学评估。本研究旨在描述巴西亚马逊帕拉州(2022-2025 年)疑似和确诊 猴痘 病例的社会人口统计学特征、时间通知趋势和临床特征。材料和方法:2022 年 3 月至 2025 年 12 月期间基于法定疾病信息系统 (SINAN) 的观察性、横断面和分析研究,遵循 STROBE 指南。样本 (N = 296) 分为确诊 猴痘 病例 (G1;n = 86) 和排除病例 (G2;n = 210)。使用 Pearson 卡方检验(对于预期细胞计数 ≥ 5)或 Fisher 精确检验(对于预期计数 < 5)评估关联性,在 SPSS v.26.0 中将显着性设置为 p < 0.05。结果:在 G1 中,感染集中在男性 (97.7%)、顺性别男性 (96.5%)、19 至 59 岁的成年人 (98.8%)、贝伦居民 (76.7%)、受过高等教育的个人 (53.5%) 以及同性恋 (73.3%) 或双性恋 (12.8%) 取向的人 (p < 0.001)。临床上,发热(81.4%;p < 0.001)和局部生殖器病变(G1 为 43.0%,G2 为 6.2%;p < 0.001)是主要表现。亲密性接触是主要的可能暴露途径(65.1%;p < 0.001)。在 G1 期观察到 HIV 合并感染的比例很高 (54.7%),报告与免疫抑制状态完全重叠,同时 23.3% 的人在收到通知时出现活动性 STI (p < 0.001),主要是活动性梅毒 (16.3%)。临床治疗主要为门诊治疗(住院率为 7.0%;p = 0.261),有效确诊病例的治愈率为 96.5%。确诊病例中没有发生 猴痘 归因的死亡,但 G1 中全因 猴痘 的死亡率为 2.3% (n = 2)。结论:帕拉州的 猴痘 病例集中在州首府,与年轻人之间的亲密性接触网络有关,其特点是 HIV 和梅毒合并感染频率较高。

title: Disclosing pathogenic processes of monkeypox (MPOX) and drug repurposing through host-transcriptomics analysis
abstract: Monkeypox (MPOX) virus infection outbreak in Africa in 2022 was initially considered a neglected tropical disease (NTD). Now it is recognized as a global health problem. The recent global spread has emphasized the need for increased attention to combat MPOX. Although there are some vaccines against MPOX, most people worldwide are still not vaccinated due to their unawareness or unavailability. However, so far, there is no approved drug against MPOX yet. Therefore, effective drugs against MPOX are also essential. This study attempted to disclose pathogenic processes and therapeutic strategies of MPOX based on MPOX-associated host key-genes (hKGs). At first, three transcriptomic profile datasets were analyzed, identifying 166 common host differentially expressed genes (hDEGs) between MPOX patients and control groups, comprising 75 upregulated and 91 downregulated hDEGs. Subsequently, six top-ranked host key genes (hKGs): ALB, HSP90AA1, CDH1, PTPRC, IGF1, and ABL1, were identified as potential MPOX-causing genes through protein-protein interaction (PPI) network analysis. Functional enrichment analysis of these hKGs revealed critical pathogenic processes of MPOX infection, including biological processes, molecular functions, cellular components, and KEGG pathways. Regulatory network analysis involving transcription factors and miRNAs provided further insights into disease mechanisms. Based on molecular docking analysis, five top-ranked drug molecules Tecovirimat, Beclabuvir, Maraviroc, Raltegravir, and Brincidofovir were identified as potential repurposable therapeutics against MPOX. ADME/T and drug-likeness evaluations confirmed favorable pharmacokinetic properties for these candidates. Additionally, 100 ns molecular dynamics (MD) simulations of the top three complexes (ALB-Tecovirimat, CDH1-Maraviroc, and PPARG-Beclabuvir) demonstrated strong binding stability, supported by RMSD, RMSF, and MM-GBSA results. Therefore, the results provided in this study might be potential resources for diagnosis and therapies of MPOX patients. However, the findings require experimental validation in wet lab for further confirmation.

abstract_zh: 2022 年非洲发生的猴痘(猴痘)病毒感染 暴发 最初被认为是一种被忽视的热带病(NTD)。现在它被认为是一个全球性的健康问题。最近的全球蔓延强调了需要加大力度打击 猴痘。尽管存在一些针对 猴痘 的 疫苗,但全世界大多数人由于不了解或无法获得疫苗,仍然没有接种疫苗。然而,到目前为止,还没有针对猴痘的批准药物。因此,针对猴痘的有效药物也是必不可少的。本研究试图基于猴痘相关的宿主关键基因(hKGs)来揭示猴痘的致病过程和治疗策略。首先,分析了三个转录组图谱数据集,鉴定了 宿主 患者和对照组之间 166 个常见的 宿主 差异表达基因 (hDEG),其中包括 75 个上调 hDEG 和 91 个下调 hDEG。随后,通过蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用(PPI)网络分析,六个排名最高的 宿主 关键基因(hKG):ALB、HSP90AA1、CDH1、PTPRC、IGF1 和 ABL1 被鉴定为潜在的 宿主 致病基因。这些 hKG 的功能富集分析揭示了 猴痘 感染的关键致病过程,包括生物过程、分子功能、细胞成分和 KEGG 途径。涉及转录因子和 miRNA 的调控网络分析提供了对疾病机制的进一步见解。基于分子对接分析,五个排名靠前的药物分子 特考韦瑞、Beclabuvir、Maraviroc、Raltegravir 和 Brincidofovir 被确定为针对 猴痘 的潜在可重复利用疗法。ADME/T 和药物相似性评估证实了这些候选药物具有良好的药代动力学特性。此外,前三种复合物(ALB-特考韦瑞、CDH1-Maraviroc 和 PPARG-Beclabuvir)的 100 ns 分子动力学 (MD) 模拟显示出强大的结合稳定性,并得到 RMSD、RMSF 和 MM-GBSA 结果的支持。因此,本研究提供的结果可能是 诊断 和 猴痘 患者治疗的潜在资源。然而,该研究结果需要在湿实验室中进行实验验证才能进一步证实。

title: Molecular Epidemiology to Decipher the Transmission Networks of Mpox in an Outbreak Scenario: Applications in Thailand During the 2023 Global Health Emergency.
abstract: BACKGROUND: The 2022 MPXV global health emergency highlighted the necessity for rapid diagnostic measures in response to mpox clade IIb outbreaks. This study investigates the mpox lineages identified in Thailand during this period and explores the transmission dynamics of dominant lineages. METHODS: Using targeted next-generation sequencing from 162 individuals infected with mpox, we created a transmission network map by linking high-similarity sequences through molecular-temporal distance matrices. RESULTS: Our findings reveal that the study population aligns with global trends of transmission almost exclusively within the community of men who have sex with men, with a majority of cases resulting from lineage C viruses as well as 8 additional sublineages. Within the observed substitutions, a majority of mutations were either G→A (n = 289, 49.74%) or C→T (n = 221, 38.04%), indicating APOBEC-3-driven deaminase activity. We also present a global transmission network for lineage C mpox genomes, illustrating domestic and international spread. CONCLUSIONS: This research underscores the significance of whole genome sequencing in diagnostics during outbreaks and the importance of sharing genomic data to enhance our understanding of disease transmission on a global scale.

title_zh: 分子 流行病学 在 暴发 场景中破译 猴痘 的 传播 网络:2023 年全球卫生紧急情况期间在泰国的应用。
source_body_en: BACKGROUND: The 2022 MPXV global health emergency highlighted the necessity for rapid diagnostic measures in response to mpox clade IIb outbreaks. This study investigates the mpox lineages identified in Thailand during this period and explores the transmission dynamics of dominant lineages. METHODS: Using targeted next-generation sequencing from 162 individuals infected with mpox, we created a transmission network map by linking high-similarity sequences through molecular-temporal distance matrices. RESULTS: Our findings reveal that the study population aligns with global trends of transmission almost exclusively within the community of men who have sex with men, with a majority of cases resulting from lineage C viruses as well as 8 additional sublineages. Within the observed substitutions, a majority of mutations were either G→A (n = 289, 49.74%) or C→T (n = 221, 38.04%), indicating APOBEC-3-driven deaminase activity. We also present a global transmission network for lineage C mpox genomes, illustrating domestic and international spread. CONCLUSIONS: This research underscores the significance of whole genome sequencing in diagnostics during outbreaks and the importance of sharing genomic data to enhance our understanding of disease transmission on a global scale.

title: The aminoadamantane derivative 3F2 modulates monocyte and NK cell activation and restores immune mediators altered by Monkeypox virus stimuli
abstract: Abstract The monkeypox virus (MPV) is known to employ multiple immune evasion strategies that compromise antiviral defenses and disrupt immune homeostasis. Here, we characterized the immune responses induced by stimulation with inactivated MPV and evaluated the ability of aminoadamantane (AMA) and its derivative, 3F2, to restore immune function. Peripheral blood mononuclear cells that were stimulated with MPV exhibited altered activation in a subset of monocytes, along with suppressed activation of natural killer (NK) and natural killer T (NKT) cells. MPV stimulation also led to significant changes in the levels of immunosoluble mediators, including reductions in chemokines and cytokines that are crucial for antiviral defense and immune regulation. Treatment with 3F2 proved to be more effective than AMA, resulting in significantly higher levels of CCL2, CXCL8, IFN-γ, IL-12(p40), IL-15, IL-5, and essential growth factors such as VEGF and NGF-β. Furthermore, 3F2 treatment partially reverses monocyte activation and re-establishes NK and NKT cell function. The current results indicate that 3F2 can control inflammation while preserving antiviral responsiveness. These findings demonstrate that inactivated MPV stimuli profoundly modulates innate immune activation and identify 3F2 as a promising immunomodulatory candidate capable of partially restoring immune responses altered by viral particle stimulation.
authors: Thaís de Fátima da Silva Moraes

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在表征 MPV 刺激诱导的 免疫应答 并评估 3F2 恢复免疫功能的能力。众所周知,猴痘病毒 (MPV) 采用多种免疫逃避策略,损害 抗病毒药物 防御并破坏免疫稳态。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究评估了用灭活 MPV 刺激的外周血单核细胞中的 免疫应答。该研究是在实验室环境中使用人类捐赠者的细胞进行的。
elements_zh.methods: 用灭活的 MPV 刺激外周血单核细胞,然后暴露于氨基金刚烷 (AMA) 及其衍生物 3F2。评估了单核细胞、NK 和 NKT 细胞的激活状态,以及趋化因子和细胞因子等免疫可溶性介质的水平。
elements_zh.main_results: MPV 刺激导致免疫可溶性介质水平发生显着变化,包括对 抗病毒药物 防御和免疫调节至关重要的趋化因子和细胞因子的减少。治疗 与 3F2 联合使用可显着提高 CCL2、CXCL8、IFN-γ、IL-12(p40)、IL-15、IL-5 和必需生长因子(如 VEGF 和 NGF-β)的水平。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,事实证明,3F2 治疗 在恢复免疫功能方面比 AMA 更有效。这些发现表明,灭活的 MPV 刺激可深刻调节先天免疫激活,并将 3F2 确定为一种有前途的免疫调节候选物,能够部分恢复病毒颗粒刺激改变的 免疫应答。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,3F2 可能是调节 猴痘 疾病中 免疫应答 的潜在治疗剂。他们还强调了了解 MPV 感染背景下的免疫调节对于制定有针对性的干预措施的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到体外模型使用的限制,并且没有考虑体内效应。证据是强有力的,因为它直接比较了 3F2 和 AMA 对免疫介质和激活状态的影响,并具有清晰的数值结果。

Treatment with 3F2 proved to be more effective than AMA, resulting in significantly higher levels of CCL2, CXCL8, IFN-γ, IL-12(p40), IL-15, IL-5, and essential growth factors such as VEGF and NGF-β. Furthermore, 3F2 treatment partially reverses monocyte activation and re-establishes NK and NKT cell function. The current results indicate that 3F2 can control inflammation while preserving antiviral responsiveness. These findings demonstrate that inactivated MPV stimuli profoundly modulates innate immune activation and identify 3F2 as a promising immunomodulatory candidate capable of partially restoring immune responses altered by viral particle stimulation.

title: Public Knowledge, Attitudes, and Preventive Practices Regarding Mpox in Bangladesh: Insights From a Community-Based Cross-Sectional Survey.
abstract: BACKGROUND AND AIMS: Mpox has recently re-emerged as a significant global health concern, highlighting the importance of public awareness and preventive measures. This study aimed to assess the knowledge, attitudes, and practices (KAP) regarding Mpox and its epidemiology, prevention, and control measures among the general population of Bangladesh. METHODS: A community-based cross-sectional survey was conducted from June 2024 to September 2024 among 1002 participants across 16 districts, using a multi-stage random sampling approach following STROBE guidelines. Data were collected through a structured questionnaire covering sociodemographics, knowledge, attitudes, and practices. Both univariate and multivariate logistic regression analyses were used to determine associations between sociodemographic factors and KAP outcomes. RESULTS: Out of 1002 respondents, only 37.2% demonstrated good knowledge of Mpox, while 74.0% had positive attitudes, and 80.0% reported satisfactory preventive practices. Awareness of Mpox as a viral disease was limited (37.3%), and only 22.5% knew about the protective role of smallpox vaccination. Higher education was strongly associated with good knowledge (AOR = 11.8; 95% CI: 5.61-25.8), positive attitudes (AOR = 5.68; 95% CI: 2.63-12.5), and satisfactory practices (AOR = 6.49; 95% CI: 2.62-16.8). Non-border residents were more likely to report positive attitudes (AOR = 3.07; p < 0.001) and satisfactory practices (AOR = 3.84; p < 0.001). Urban (AOR = 2.28; p = 0.003) and semi-urban (AOR = 2.19; p = 0.014) participants showed more positive attitudes. Attitudes and practices showed the strongest correlation (ρ = 0.793, p < 0.001), indicating a strong association between attitudes and preventive practices. CONCLUSION: The findings suggest that gaps in awareness and training are associated with suboptimal practices, highlighting potential areas for targeted educational interventions. Strengthening community-level awareness and preparedness may support public health readiness for potential Mpox outbreaks in Bangladesh.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 猴痘 最近重新成为全球重大健康问题,凸显了公众意识和预防措施的重要性。本研究旨在评估孟加拉国普通民众对 猴痘 及其 流行病学、预防和控制措施的知识、态度和实践 (KAP)。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2024 年 6 月至 2024 年 9 月,对 16 个地区的 1002 名参与者进行了一项基于社区的横断面调查。该研究主要针对孟加拉国的一般人群,采用遵循 STROBE 指南的多阶段随机抽样方法。
elements_zh.methods: 通过结构化调查问卷收集数据,涵盖社会人口统计、知识、态度和实践。使用单变量和多变量逻辑回归分析来确定社会人口因素与 KAP 结果之间的关联。
elements_zh.main_results: 在 1002 名受访者中,只有 37.2% 的人对 猴痘 表现出良好的了解,而 74.0% 的人持积极态度,80.0% 的人表示令人满意的预防措施。高等教育与良好知识(AOR = 11.8;95% CI:5.61-25.8)、积极态度(AOR = 5.68;95% CI:2.63-12.5)和令人满意的实践(AOR = 6.49;95% CI:2.62-16.8)密切相关。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,意识和培训方面的差距与次优实践有关,凸显了有针对性的教育干预的潜在领域。态度和实践表现出最强的相关性(ρ = 0.793,p < 0.001),表明态度和预防实践之间存在很强的关联。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 对 猴痘 作为病毒性疾病的认识有限(37.3%),只有 22.5% 的人知道天花 疫苗接种 的保护作用。加强社区层面的认识和准备可能有助于孟加拉国为潜在的 猴痘 暴发 做好公共卫生准备。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到横截面设计的限制,无法确定因果关系。证据是中等的,因为它基于自我报告的数据和关联,而不是直接的生物学或临床结果。

Awareness of Mpox as a viral disease was limited (37.3%), and only 22.5% knew about the protective role of smallpox vaccination. Higher education was strongly associated with good knowledge (AOR = 11.8; 95% CI: 5.61-25.8), positive attitudes (AOR = 5.68; 95% CI: 2.63-12.5), and satisfactory practices (AOR = 6.49; 95% CI: 2.62-16.8). Non-border residents were more likely to report positive attitudes (AOR = 3.07; p < 0.001) and satisfactory practices (AOR = 3.84; p < 0.001). Urban (AOR = 2.28; p = 0.003) and semi-urban (AOR = 2.19; p = 0.014) participants showed more positive attitudes. Attitudes and practices showed the strongest correlation (ρ = 0.793, p < 0.001), indicating a strong association between attitudes and preventive practices. CONCLUSION: The findings suggest that gaps in awareness and training are associated with suboptimal practices, highlighting potential areas for targeted educational interventions. Strengthening community-level awareness and preparedness may support public health readiness for potential Mpox outbreaks in Bangladesh.

title: Conservation guided reverse vaccinology for the design of a broadly immunogenic multi-epitope vaccine against monkeypox virus
abstract: Mpox, caused by the Monkeypox virus (MPXV), has emerged as a global public health concern following outbreaks beyond its traditional endemic regions. Although existing smallpox-derived vaccines provide partial protection, their limitations and declining population immunity highlight the need for safer and more targeted vaccine strategies. This study aimed to identify conserved antigenic targets and design a multi-epitope vaccine candidate against MPXV using a conservation-guided immunoinformatics approach. A dataset of 27 complete MPXV genomes (2001–2025) from diverse geographic regions was analyzed to identify highly conserved viral genes. Conserved surface-exposed proteins were prioritized for epitope prediction, including cytotoxic T-lymphocyte, helper T-lymphocyte, and B-cell epitopes. High-confidence epitopes were selected based on binding affinity, antigenicity, immunogenicity, toxicity, allergenicity, and absence of human sequence homology. Promiscuous epitopes with broad human leukocyte antigen (HLA) binding were curated to maximize population coverage. Three multi-epitope vaccine constructs were designed using appropriate linkers and adjuvants. Structural modeling, molecular docking with innate immune receptors, immune response simulation, and codon optimization were performed to evaluate the constructs. All constructs were predicted to be stable, antigenic, and non-allergenic. Molecular docking indicated strong interactions of vaccine construct 2 (VC2) with TLR2 and the TLR4–MD-2 complex, achieving the highest binding affinities (ΔG = − 19.6 and − 27.8 kcal/mol, respectively). Immune simulations predicted robust humoral and cellular responses, including strong antibody production and interferon-γ induction for VC2. Population coverage analysis estimated 99.27% global coverage, and codon optimization suggested efficient expression in Escherichia coli . Overall, VC2 emerges as a promising multi-epitope vaccine candidate with strong predicted immunogenic and structural properties. While these computational findings lay a solid foundation, VC2 require further experimental validation and preclinical development as a targeted vaccine strategy against MPXV.

title_zh: 保护引导反向疫苗学设计抗猴痘病毒的广泛免疫原性多表位 疫苗
source_body_en: Mpox, caused by the Monkeypox virus (MPXV), has emerged as a global public health concern following outbreaks beyond its traditional endemic regions. Although existing smallpox-derived vaccines provide partial protection, their limitations and declining population immunity highlight the need for safer and more targeted vaccine strategies. This study aimed to identify conserved antigenic targets and design a multi-epitope vaccine candidate against MPXV using a conservation-guided immunoinformatics approach. A dataset of 27 complete MPXV genomes (2001–2025) from diverse geographic regions was analyzed to identify highly conserved viral genes. Conserved surface-exposed proteins were prioritized for epitope prediction, including cytotoxic T-lymphocyte, helper T-lymphocyte, and B-cell epitopes. High-confidence epitopes were selected based on binding affinity, antigenicity, immunogenicity, toxicity, allergenicity, and absence of human sequence homology. Promiscuous epitopes with broad human leukocyte antigen (HLA) binding were curated to maximize population coverage. Three multi-epitope vaccine constructs were designed using appropriate linkers and adjuvants. Structural modeling, molecular docking with innate immune receptors, immune response simulation, and codon optimization were performed to evaluate the constructs. All constructs were predicted to be stable, antigenic, and non-allergenic. Molecular docking indicated strong interactions of vaccine construct 2 (VC2) with TLR2 and the TLR4–MD-2 complex, achieving the highest binding affinities (ΔG = − 19.6 and − 27.8 kcal/mol, respectively). Immune simulations predicted robust humoral and cellular responses, including strong antibody production and interferon-γ induction for VC2. Population coverage analysis estimated 99.27% global coverage, and codon optimization suggested efficient expression in Escherichia coli . Overall, VC2 emerges as a promising multi-epitope vaccine candidate with strong predicted immunogenic and structural properties. While these computational findings lay a solid foundation, VC2 require further experimental validation and preclinical development as a targeted vaccine strategy against MPXV.
abstract_zh: 猴痘 是由猴痘病毒 (MPXV) 引起的,继 暴发 超越其传统流行地区之后,已成为全球公共卫生问题。尽管现有的天花衍生 疫苗 提供了部分保护,但其局限性和人群免疫力下降突出表明需要更安全、更有针对性的 疫苗 策略。本研究旨在识别保守的抗原靶标,并使用保守引导的免疫信息学方法设计针对 MPXV 的多表位 疫苗 候选药物。对来自不同地理区域的 27 个完整 MPXV 基因组 (2001-2025) 的数据集进行了分析,以识别高度保守的病毒基因。保守的表面暴露蛋白优先用于表位预测,包括细胞毒性 T 淋巴细胞、辅助 T 淋巴细胞和 B 细胞表位。根据结合亲和力、抗原性、免疫原性、毒性、过敏原性和人类序列同源性的缺乏来选择高置信度表位。精心设计了具有广泛人类白细胞抗原 (HLA) 结合的混杂表位,以最大限度地扩大人群覆盖范围。使用适当的接头和佐剂设计了三个多表位 疫苗 构建体。进行结构建模、与先天免疫受体的分子对接、免疫应答 模拟和密码子优化来评估构建体。预计所有构建体都是稳定的、抗原性的和非过敏性的。分子对接表明 疫苗 构建体 2 (VC2) 与 TLR2 和 TLR4-MD-2 复合物有很强的相互作用,实现了最高的结合亲和力(分别为 ΔG = − 19.6 和 − 27.8 kcal/mol)。免疫模拟预测了强烈的体液和细胞反应,包括强抗体产生和 VC2 的干扰素-γ 诱导。群体覆盖度分析估计全球覆盖度为 99.27%,密码子优化表明在大肠杆菌中有效表达。总体而言,VC2 成为一种有前途的多表位 疫苗 候选药物,具有强大的预测免疫原性和结构特性。虽然这些计算结果奠定了坚实的基础,但 VC2 需要进一步的实验验证和临床前开发,作为针对 MPXV 的有针对性的 疫苗 策略。

title: Monkeypox Virus Surveillance in Wastewater, North Carolina, USA, October 2023–May 2025
abstract: In September 2023, the North Carolina Department of Health and Human Services identified a new case of mpox clade II 5 months after the last previous report. To assess possible unrecognized transmission, nonvariola orthopoxvirus testing was implemented at select wastewater sites. During October 29, 2023–May 2025, a total of 801 samples were collected across 16 treatment plants serving ≈2 million residents. We analyzed wastewater detections (n = 47) and clinical cases (n = 45) using a +17-day window. Overall sensitivity of identifying the presence of >1 temporally aligned mpox case within a sewershed was 10.6% (95% CI 6.5%–16.7%); specificity was 95.1% (95% CI 93.2%–96.5%), positive predictive value was 31.9% (95% CI 20.4%–46.2%), and negative predictive value was 83.2% (95% CI 80.3%–85.7%). Restricting detections above the limit of detection reduced sensitivity but increased specificity. Overall, wastewater surveillance showed low sensitivity but provided complementary awareness for public health response.

analysis.research_question_and_background: In September 2023, the North Carolina Department of Health and Human Services identified a new case of mpox clade II 5 months after the last previous report, highlighting the need for enhanced surveillance to detect possible unrecognized transmission.
analysis.study_design_and_population: To assess possible unrecognized transmission, nonvariola orthopoxvirus testing was implemented at select wastewater sites during October 29, 2023–May 2025, across 16 treatment plants serving approximately 2 million residents.
analysis.methods: During October 29, 2023–May 2025, a total of 801 samples were collected across 16 treatment plants serving ≈2 million residents. We analyzed wastewater detections (n = 47) and clinical cases (n = 45) using a +17-day window.
analysis.main_results: Overall sensitivity of identifying the presence of >1 temporally aligned mpox case within a sewershed was 10.6% (95% CI 6.5%–16.7%); specificity was 95.1% (95% CI 93.2%–96.5%), positive predictive value was 31.9% (95% CI 20.4%–46.2%), and negative predictive value was 83.2% (95% CI 80.3%–85.7%).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: Restricting detections above the limit of detection reduced sensitivity but increased specificity, indicating a trade-off in detection accuracy based on threshold settings.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Wastewater surveillance showed low sensitivity but provided complementary awareness for public health response, supporting the use of this method as an adjunct to clinical monitoring.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study found that wastewater surveillance had low sensitivity, which may limit its effectiveness in detecting all cases, but the evidence is moderate in strength due to the clear reporting of statistical measures.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to evaluate the utility of wastewater surveillance for detecting mpox virus transmission in North Carolina. From October 2023 to May 2025, 801 samples were collected from 16 wastewater treatment plants. The analysis revealed that wastewater testing had low sensitivity but high specificity, with a 10.6% sensitivity and 95.1% specificity in identifying temporally aligned mpox cases. title: Geospatial analysis and predictive modelling of mpox transmission hotspots: a case study of Ogun State, Nigeria
abstract: Mpox is a recurring public health threat in Nigeria and was re-declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern in August 2024. Nigeria's Integrated Disease Surveillance and Response system operates at the Local Government Area (LGA) level, yet published mpox risk models resolve risk only at state level, forcing uniform deployment across heterogeneous LGAs. This study developed and evaluated an LGA-resolution geospatial risk layer for the 20 LGAs of Ogun State and integrated it, as a proof of concept, into a live surveillance platform. State-level records of 40 laboratory-confirmed cases (NCDC, 2022) and 151 suspected cases (Ogun State Ministry of Health, 2022–2024), 191 in total, were spatially disaggregated into 189 pseudo-presence points and modelled with an ensemble of maximum entropy, random forest, and extreme gradient boosting over 100 bootstrap replicates. Discrimination was good under random hold-out (AUC 0.77; Boyce index 0.99) but fell under spatially blocked cross-validation (AUC 0.57), indicating that the layer is suited to coarse triage between tiers rather than within-tier ranking. Seven LGAs were classified high risk along a central corridor anchored on Abeokuta South and the Ijebu–Remo axis, six medium, and seven low. The tiered layer was exported as GeoJSON with tier-specific action packages and integrated into the IDS-Master platform as a proof-of-concept pathway from spatial epidemiology to routine public health surveillance. Because the 189 points were disaggregated from aggregate counts rather than individually geolocated, the tiers should be read as a spatial prior for triage rather than as confirmed case locations.

This study developed and evaluated an LGA-resolution geospatial risk layer for the 20 LGAs of Ogun State and integrated it, as a proof of concept, into a live surveillance platform. State-level records of 40 laboratory-confirmed cases (NCDC, 2022) and 151 suspected cases (Ogun State Ministry of Health, 2022–2024), 191 in total, were spatially disaggregated into 189 pseudo-presence points and modelled with an ensemble of maximum entropy, random forest, and extreme gradient boosting over 100 bootstrap replicates. Discrimination was good under random hold-out (AUC 0.77; Boyce index 0.99) but fell under spatially blocked cross-validation (AUC 0.57), indicating that the layer is suited to coarse triage between tiers rather than within-tier ranking. Seven LGAs were classified high risk along a central corridor anchored on Abeokuta South and the Ijebu–Remo axis, six medium, and seven low. The tiered layer was exported as GeoJSON with tier-specific action packages and integrated into the IDS-Master platform as a proof-of-concept pathway from spatial epidemiology to routine public health surveillance. Because the 189 points were disaggregated from aggregate counts rather than individually geolocated, the tiers should be read as a spatial prior for triage rather than as confirmed case locations.
abstract_zh: 猴痘 是尼日利亚反复出现的公共卫生威胁,并于 2024 年 8 月被重新宣布为国际关注的突发公共卫生事件。尼日利亚的综合疾病 猴痘 和响应系统在地方政府地区 (LGA) 层面运行,但发布的 猴痘 风险模型仅在州层面解决风险,迫使异构地方政府地区进行统一部署。本研究开发并评估了奥贡州 20 个 LGA 的 LGA 分辨率地理空间风险层,并将其作为概念验证集成到实时 监测 平台中。40 例实验室确诊病例(NCDC,2022 年)和 151 例疑似病例(奥贡州卫生部,2022 年至 2024 年)的州级记录,总共 191 例,在空间上分解为 189 个伪存在点,并使用最大熵、随机森林和极端梯度提升的集合建模,超过 100 个引导重复。在随机保留下(AUC 0.77;博伊斯指数 0.99),歧视性良好,但在空间阻塞交叉验证(AUC 0.57)下,歧视性下降,表明该层适合于层之间的粗略分类,而不是层内排名。沿阿贝奥库塔南和伊杰布-雷莫轴线的中央走廊,有 7 个地方政府行政区被列为高风险,6 个为中风险,7 个为低风险。分层层导出为具有特定于层的操作包的 GeoJSON,并集成到 IDS-Master 平台中,作为从空间 流行病学 到常规公共卫生 流行病学 的概念验证途径。由于 189 个点是从总计数中分解出来的,而不是单独进行地理定位的,因此这些层应被解读为分诊的空间先验,而不是已确认的病例位置。

title: HECA-YOLOv11: A High-Accuracy Hybrid Attention Network for Real-Time Monkeypox Skin Lesion Detection with Interpretability
abstract: Introduction: The global outbreak risk of monkeypox necessitates efficient diagnostic tools. Current methods are slow and struggle to differentiate similar skin lesions, while deep learning models lack both accuracy and interpretability for multi-class classification. This study aims to develop a high-performance, real-time screening tool for early detection of monkeypox and similar conditions. Methods: This study proposes an enhanced architecture that incorporates the Highly Efficient Channel Attention (HECA) mechanism into YOLOv11 to improve feature selection. HECA performs Global Average Pooling (GAP) and Max Average Pooling (MAP) on input feature maps. Using spatial transformations and pixel-domain enhancements, the research establishes and augments a four-class dataset containing monkeypox, measles, chickenpox, and normal skin images. Gradient-Weighted Class Activation Mapping (Grad-CAM) generates heatmaps for lesion localization visualization, while a PyQt5-based interactive diagnostic interface streamlines clinical workflows. Results: Experimental results demonstrate the proposed model’s superior performance compared to existing approaches (EfficientNet-v2-l, GoogLeNet, ResNet50, VGG19, MobileNetv2, DenseNet201, and YOLOv11s) on the test set, with enhanced detection speed, accuracy (98.9%), precision (99%), recall (99.3%), and F1-score (99.1%). HECA-YOLOv11 outperforms SE-YOLOv11 and ECA-YOLOv11 by over 5.1% across all evaluation metrics. Heatmap analysis confirms the model’s focus on lesion regions, aligning with medical reasoning. Discussion: The integrated attention mechanism and interpretability techniques effectively address key limitations in automated skin lesion detection. The high performance and low latency signify a major advancement towards reliable clinical decision support, with important implications for early outbreak containment. Conclusion: The HECA-YOLOv11 framework provides a highly accurate and efficient tool for early monkeypox screening. Its standardized interface holds significant potential to accelerate public health responses and improve global control of emerging infectious diseases.
journal: Recent Advances in Computer Science and Communications

Using spatial transformations and pixel-domain enhancements, the research establishes and augments a four-class dataset containing monkeypox, measles, chickenpox, and normal skin images. Gradient-Weighted Class Activation Mapping (Grad-CAM) generates heatmaps for lesion localization visualization, while a PyQt5-based interactive diagnostic interface streamlines clinical workflows. Results: Experimental results demonstrate the proposed model’s superior performance compared to existing approaches (EfficientNet-v2-l, GoogLeNet, ResNet50, VGG19, MobileNetv2, DenseNet201, and YOLOv11s) on the test set, with enhanced detection speed, accuracy (98.9%), precision (99%), recall (99.3%), and F1-score (99.1%). HECA-YOLOv11 outperforms SE-YOLOv11 and ECA-YOLOv11 by over 5.1% across all evaluation metrics. Heatmap analysis confirms the model’s focus on lesion regions, aligning with medical reasoning. Discussion: The integrated attention mechanism and interpretability techniques effectively address key limitations in automated skin lesion detection. The high performance and low latency signify a major advancement towards reliable clinical decision support, with important implications for early outbreak containment. Conclusion: The HECA-YOLOv11 framework provides a highly accurate and efficient tool for early monkeypox screening. Its standardized interface holds significant potential to accelerate public health responses and improve global control of emerging infectious diseases.

title: Healthcare Workers’ Preparedness for Monkeypox Pandemic Response in SubSaharan Africa: A Rapid Review Investigating the Knowledge Gap
abstract: Background: Mpox is a zoonotic viral disease caused by an Orthopoxvirus endemic to sub-Saharan Africa (SSA), where its resurgence underscores the urgent need for improved preparedness among health care workers (HCWs). Despite the potential of a One Health approach, current implementations remain fragmented. This rapid review synthesises evidence on HCWs' knowledge, attitudes, information sources, and barriers to preparedness regarding Mpox in SSA to identify training needs and policy implications. Methods: Following Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) guidelines, PubMed and ScienceDirect were searched using MeSH terms and Boolean operators for studies published between 2000 and 2024. Studies assessing HCW knowledge, attitudes, or preparedness for Mpox in SSA with full-text availability in English or French were included; those involving non-HCW populations, conducted outside SSA, or lacking primary data were excluded. Two reviewers independently screened and extracted data using a standardised template; quality was assessed using the JBI Critical Appraisal Checklist for Analytical CrossSectional Studies. Results: Five studies from 388 records were included (Cameroon, Ethiopia, Nigeria, DRC; n = 1,672 HCWs). Only 46.8% of HCWs demonstrated adequate Mpox knowledge. Barriers included reliance on social media and limited access to formal training. Positive attitudes towards prevention correlated with higher knowledge levels. Conclusion: Fewer than half of SSA HCWs demonstrate adequate Mpox knowledge despite a regional case fatality rate nearly ten times the global average; positive attitudes are not translating into clinical preparedness, reflecting a critical intention-action gap; and social media dominates as an information source, underscoring the need for peer-reviewed alternatives within a One Health training framework.
journal: Journal of Clinical Virology and Translational Research

analysis.summary_en: This rapid review examines healthcare workers' (HCWs) preparedness for monkeypox (Mpox) pandemic response in sub-Saharan Africa (SSA). The review highlights that only 46.8% of HCWs have adequate knowledge about Mpox, despite its high case fatality rate in the region. Barriers to preparedness include reliance on social media for information and limited access to formal training. Positive attitudes towards prevention are associated with higher knowledge levels, but these attitudes do not translate into clinical preparedness, indicating an intention-action gap. The review underscores the need for peer-reviewed information sources and a structured One Health training framework to address these gaps. The findings suggest that targeted training and policy interventions are essential to improve HCW readiness for Mpox outbreaks in SSA.

title: A comparative analysis of cell death signalling in RNA and DNA virus infections and potential inhibitory strategies
abstract: The recent COVID-19 pandemic and the epidemic outbreak of Mpox have demonstrated that viruses, despite their apparently simple structure, are sophisticated microorganisms that have evolved complicated pro-survival mechanisms. Their potential to manipulate cell death pathways can affect and determine the outcome of the infection cycle and the host's immune response. RNA viruses typically display a more acute and aggressive nature, as they often promote cell death. In this way, they proliferate and release their virions to infect adjacent cells and perpetuate their life cycle. Common consequences of RNA virus infection include hyperinflammatory responses in hosts, typically leading in damage to the epithelial barrier. Conversely, DNA viruses modulate these pathways to sustain a balance between the lytic cycle, during which they replicate, and latency, wherein they remain inactive until an appropriate stimulus triggers reactivation. Achieving this balance and transitioning between stages of infection requires the inhibition of cellular death processes. In both instances, the viruses seem to respond to the cellular context, enhancing their adaptability through mutations, so to deceive host defenses and therefore secure their survival. This highlights the necessity to comprehend the processes via which these biological threats induce cell death, thereby facilitating the development of broad-spectrum or targeted antiviral treatments.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on the mechanisms of cell death signalling in RNA and DNA virus infections, with a particular emphasis on the Mpox virus. It explores how these viruses manipulate host cell death pathways to influence the infection cycle and immune response, and how this knowledge can inform the development of antiviral treatments.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a comparative analysis of cell death signalling in RNA and DNA virus infections. It does not explicitly report on the databases used, search dates, or eligibility criteria. The review method is primarily narrative, with general observations and comparisons drawn from existing literature on viral infections and their interactions with host cell death pathways.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that RNA viruses typically promote cell death, which facilitates their replication and spread by damaging the epithelial barrier and triggering hyperinflammatory responses. DNA viruses, on the other hand, modulate cell death pathways to maintain a balance between the lytic and latent phases of their life cycle, which is essential for their survival and reactivation.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review notes that the mechanisms by which viruses manipulate cell death pathways are not fully understood, particularly in the context of specific viral strains and their interactions with different host contexts. There is also a lack of detailed studies on the precise molecular pathways involved in these processes for the Mpox virus.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review highlights the need for further research into the molecular mechanisms of cell death manipulation by the Mpox virus. It also suggests that understanding these mechanisms could lead to the development of targeted antiviral treatments and strategies to enhance host immune responses against viral infections.

analysis.summary_en: This review compares cell death signalling in RNA and DNA virus infections, with a focus on the Mpox virus. It highlights that RNA viruses often promote cell death to facilitate their replication and spread, while DNA viruses modulate these pathways to maintain a balance between lytic and latent phases. The review underscores the importance of understanding these mechanisms to develop effective antiviral treatments and strategies. However, it also identifies gaps in knowledge regarding the precise molecular pathways involved in these processes for the Mpox virus. The findings suggest that further research is needed to explore these mechanisms in detail and to improve host immune responses against viral infections.

elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述是对 RNA 和 DNA 病毒感染中细胞死亡信号传导的比较分析。它没有明确报告所使用的数据库、检索日期或资格标准。综述方法主要是叙述性的,一般观察和比较来自关于病毒感染及其与 宿主 细胞死亡途径相互作用的现有文献。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 该综述得出的结论是,RNA 病毒通常会促进细胞死亡,从而通过破坏上皮屏障并引发过度炎症反应来促进其复制和传播。另一方面,DNA 病毒调节细胞死亡途径,以维持其生命周期的裂解期和潜伏期之间的平衡,这对于它们的生存和重新激活至关重要。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该评论指出,病毒操纵细胞死亡途径的机制尚未完全了解,特别是在特定病毒株及其与不同 宿主 背景的相互作用的背景下。对于 猴痘病毒 这些过程所涉及的精确分子途径也缺乏详细的研究。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该综述强调需要进一步研究 猴痘病毒 操纵细胞死亡的分子机制。它还表明,了解这些机制可能有助于开发靶向 抗病毒药物 治疗 以及增强 宿主 免疫应答 抗病毒感染的策略。

title: Metagenomic Description of the Feline Oral Microbiome
abstract: Abstract The domestic cat oral microbiome constitutes an important microecosystem for both feline and public health, but integrated data on bacteria and viruses at the national level are few. The present work shows that the feline oral microbiome is essentially a separate ecosystem guided above all by geography and climate, with husbandry adding more subtle control. An OAPGC has been built—a national list of 443 prokaryotic of the 969 high-quality viral genomes studied, the bacteriome seems to be largely occupied by Pseudomonadota, Bacillota, or Bacteroidota, with > 34%of species as uncultivated lineages. The virome is mostly Caudoviricetes -based, and almost half its viruses are unclassified, an indication of great novelty in this context. Functionally, the majority of temperate phages appear to change frequently between lytic and lysogenic cycles,a tight regulation of bacterial homeostasis matched to environmental fluctuations. Of particular interest is the fact that monkeypox virus failed to appear in any of the 1, 454 tested samples—cats are not now reservoirs or vectors. Taken together, these results reveal great geographic variation, massive microbial“dark matter,”and vital viral control mechanisms. They set out a nation-wide baseline for companion animal oral microbiomes and thus help to evaluate feline pathogenesis, anticipate spillover into humans, and implement“One Health”-based approaches.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to characterize the feline oral microbiome, particularly focusing on the presence and distribution of viruses, to better understand its role in feline and public health. The background highlights the lack of integrated data on bacteria and viruses at the national level in this context.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved a national-level analysis of the feline oral microbiome, examining 1,454 tested samples to identify the composition of the virome and bacteriome across different geographical regions.
analysis.methods: The researchers conducted metagenomic sequencing to analyze the oral microbiome, generating a comprehensive list of 969 high-quality viral genomes and identifying 443 prokaryotic species. They categorized the virome based on viral classifications and assessed the functional roles of the identified viruses.
analysis.main_results: The virome was predominantly composed of Caudoviricetes, with almost half of the viruses being unclassified. The bacteriome was largely dominated by Pseudomonadota, Bacillota, and Bacteroidota, with over 34% of species being uncultivated lineages.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that the feline oral microbiome is a distinct ecosystem influenced by geography and climate, with significant functional diversity in viral populations. The study reveals the presence of a large amount of microbial 'dark matter' and highlights the dynamic regulation of bacterial homeostasis by viral activity.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results provide a baseline for understanding feline oral microbiomes and their potential role in disease transmission, offering insights into the ecological dynamics that may influence spillover into humans and informing One Health strategies.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to abstract-level reporting, and the evidence is based on a national sample of 1,454 tested samples. The confidence in these findings is moderate due to the lack of detailed experimental data and the reliance on metagenomic analysis without further validation.

analysis.summary_en: This study provides a metagenomic description of the feline oral microbiome, emphasizing its role as a distinct ecosystem influenced by geography and climate. The research identified a national list of 969 high-quality viral genomes and 443 prokaryotic species, with the virome predominantly composed of Caudoviricetes and the bacteriome dominated by Pseudomonadota, Bacillota, and Bacteroidota. The findings highlight the presence of significant microbial 'dark matter' and the dynamic regulation of bacterial homeostasis by viral activity. These results contribute to understanding the ecological dynamics of the feline oral microbiome and its potential implications for disease transmission and public health. However, the study is limited to abstract-level reporting, and the evidence is based on a national sample of 1,454 tested samples, resulting in moderate confidence in the findings.

abstract_zh: 摘要 家猫口腔微生物群构成了猫科动物和公共卫生的重要微生态系统,但国家层面有关细菌和病毒的综合数据很少。目前的工作表明,猫科动物口腔微生物群本质上是一个独立的生态系统,首先受地理和气候的影响,而畜牧业则增加了更微妙的控制。OAPGC 已经建立——一份包含 969 种高质量病毒 基因组 中 443 种原核生物的国家名单,细菌组似乎主要被假单胞菌门、芽孢杆菌门或拟杆菌门占据,其中超过 34% 的物种为未培养谱系。该病毒组主要是基于Caudoviricetes的,并且几乎一半的病毒是未分类的,这表明在这方面具有很大的新颖性。从功能上讲,大多数温带噬菌体似乎在裂解和溶原循环之间频繁变化,这是与环境波动相匹配的细菌稳态的严格调节。特别令人感兴趣的是,猴痘病毒未能出现在 1,454 个测试样本中的任何一个中——猫现在不是 储存宿主 或 媒介。总而言之,这些结果揭示了巨大的地理差异、大量的微生物“暗物质”和重要的病毒控制机制。他们为伴侣动物口腔微生物组制定了全国范围的基线,从而帮助评估猫科动物 发病机制、预测人类的 跨物种溢出 并实施基于“One Health”的方法。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在描述猫科动物口腔微生物组的特征,特别关注病毒的存在和分布,以更好地了解其在猫科动物和公共卫生中的作用。这一背景凸显了在这方面缺乏国家层面的细菌和病毒综合数据。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究涉及对猫科动物口腔微生物组进行国家级分析,检查了 1,454 个测试样本,以确定不同地理区域的病毒组和细菌组的组成。
analysis_zh.methods: 研究人员进行了宏基因组测序来分析口腔微生物组,生成了 969 种高质量病毒 基因组 的综合列表,并鉴定了 443 种原核生物物种。他们根据病毒分类对病毒组进行分类,并评估已识别病毒的功能作用。
analysis_zh.main_results: 病毒组主要由有尾病毒纲组成,几乎一半的病毒未分类。细菌组主要以假单胞菌门、芽孢杆菌门和拟杆菌门为主,其中超过 34% 的物种是未培养的谱系。

title: Forecasting of infectious disease epidemics in sexual networks using attenuated renewal processes
abstract: Forecasting emerging infectious disease outbreaks is particularly challenging for sexual networks of men who have sex with men (MSM), where transmission can be shaped by heterogeneous and overdispersed contact structures, mixing assortativity, and both one-time and recurrent partnerships. Using stochastic epidemic simulations on synthetic MSM networks and empirical mpox case data from major cities, we systematically evaluated five classes of short-term forecasting models, from random walk approaches to semi-mechanistic attenuated renewal processes. Model performance was assessed using the continuous ranked probability score (CRPS). Across both simulated and empirical epidemics in heterogeneous networks, renewal models attenuated by a reverse-sigmoid curve, to account for early depletion of highly-connected nodes, consistently outperformed alternatives, achieving more balanced and reliable forecasts. Our findings suggest a practical approach for robust forecasting in highly overdispersed networks, where distinguishing network effects from other factors remains challenging and usually requires additional data.

analysis_zh.methods: 使用连续排名概率得分 (CRPS) 评估模型性能,以比较不同方法的预测准确性。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在模拟流行病和实证流行病中,通过反向 S 形曲线衰减的更新模型都优于替代模型,在异构网络中提供了更加平衡和可靠的预测。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果提出了一种在高度过度分散的网络中进行稳健预测的实用方法,在这种网络中,如果没有额外的数据,通常很难将网络效应与其他因素区分开来。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果为改善性网络中的 暴发 预测提供了一个有价值的工具,可以为 监测 的公共卫生策略以及 猴痘 和类似疾病的干预提供信息。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于仅抽象的证据,虽然模型表现出一致的性能,但它们对其他环境的普遍性可能需要进一步验证。

title: Ectromelia Virus Reprograms the Noncanonical NF-κB Signaling Pathway in HeLa Epithelial Cells
abstract: Abstract The noncanonical nuclear factor κB (NF-κB) pathway regulates adaptive immune responses and antiviral innate immunity. Orthopoxviruses, including the human pathogen variola virus and zoonotic viruses such as vaccinia virus and monkeypox virus, have evolved multiple strategies to suppress host antiviral signaling. Our previous work using in vitro immune cell models demonstrated that the mouse-specific orthopoxvirus ectromelia virus (ECTV) inhibits the noncanonical NF-κB signaling pathway. Here, we investigated the impact of ECTV on noncanonical NF-κB signaling in human epithelial HeLa cells. Tumor necrosis factor superfamily ligands were used to activate or modulate noncanonical NF-κB signaling. Using fluorescence microscopy and immunoblot analyses, we found that ECTV reduced LIGHT (TNFSF14)- and lymphotoxin α 1 β 2 (LTα 1 β 2 )-induced nuclear accumulation of the NF-κB subunits RelB and p52. ECTV infection alone increased whole-cell RelB and NF-κB2/p100 levels but did not significantly alter nuclear RelB levels. In TNF-α-stimulated cells, ECTV reduced levels of cellular inhibitor of apoptosis protein 2 (cIAP2), whereas in LTα 1 β 2 -stimulated cells, ECTV reduced levels of TNF receptor-associated factor 3 (TRAF3). RT-qPCR analysis revealed that ECTV upregulated RELB , NFKB2 , and CHUK expression. Viral infection also increased expression of TNFAIP3 and OTUD7B , genes encoding regulators of noncanonical NF-κB signaling. Moreover, infected cells exhibited increased expression of selected RelB-responsive genes, including FBRS , CCR10 , and TNFRSF6B . Together, these findings indicate that ECTV modulates components associated with noncanonical NF-κB signaling in epithelial cells in vitro , without evidence of constitutive pathway activation.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate the impact of ECTV on noncanonical NF-κB signaling in human epithelial HeLa cells, building on prior knowledge that orthopoxviruses suppress host antiviral signaling.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study used in vitro models of human epithelial HeLa cells to examine the effects of ECTV infection on noncanonical NF-κB signaling, with a focus on the mouse-specific orthopoxvirus ECTV.
analysis.methods: The researchers employed fluorescence microscopy and immunoblot analyses to assess nuclear accumulation of NF-κB subunits, and RT-qPCR to measure gene expression levels related to noncanonical NF-κB signaling.
analysis.main_results: ECTV reduced LIGHT- and LTα 1 β 2 -induced nuclear accumulation of RelB and p52, increased whole-cell RelB and NF-κB2/p100 levels, and upregulated RELB, NFKB2, and CHUK expression. It also increased TNFAIP3 and OTUD7B expression and selected RelB-responsive genes.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that ECTV modulates noncanonical NF-κB signaling components in epithelial cells without constitutive pathway activation, highlighting a novel mechanism of immune evasion.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results contribute to understanding how mpox virus manipulates host immune pathways, which could inform future research on viral pathogenesis and potential therapeutic targets.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to in vitro models, which may not fully represent in vivo dynamics, and the evidence is based on abstract-only data, resulting in a moderate confidence assessment.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates how ectromelia virus (ECTV) affects noncanonical NF-κB signaling in human epithelial HeLa cells. The research builds on prior knowledge that orthopoxviruses, including ECTV, suppress host antiviral signaling. Using in vitro models, the study found that ECTV reduces nuclear accumulation of NF-κB subunits RelB and p52 in response to ligands like LIGHT and LTα 1 β 2, while increasing whole-cell levels of RelB and NF-κB2/p100. RT-qPCR analysis revealed upregulation of RELB, NFKB2, and CHUK, as well as increased expression of TNFAIP3 and OTUD7B. Additionally, infected cells showed elevated expression of selected RelB-responsive genes. These findings suggest that ECTV modulates noncanonical NF-κB signaling without constitutive activation, offering new insights into its immune evasion mechanisms. However, the study is limited to in vitro models, and the evidence is based on abstract-only data, which limits the confidence in the conclusions.

abstract_zh: 摘要:非经典核因子 κB (NF-κB) 通路调节适应性 免疫应答 和 抗病毒药物 先天免疫。正痘病毒,包括人类病原体天花病毒和人畜共患病毒,如牛痘病毒和猴痘病毒,已经进化出多种策略来抑制 宿主 抗病毒药物 信号传导。我们之前使用体外免疫细胞模型的工作表明,小鼠特异性 正痘病毒 ectromelia 病毒 (ECTV) 抑制非经典 NF-κB 信号通路。在这里,我们研究了 ECTV 对人上皮 HeLa 细胞中非典型 NF-κB 信号传导的影响。肿瘤坏死因子超家族配体用于激活或调节非经典 NF-κB 信号传导。使用荧光显微镜和免疫印迹分析,我们发现 ECTV 减少了 LIGHT (TNFSF14) 和淋巴毒素 α 1 β 2 (LTα 1 β 2 ) 诱导的 NF-κB 亚基 RelB 和 p52 的核积累。ECTV 单独感染增加了全细胞 RelB 和 NF-κB2/p100 水平,但没有显着改变核 RelB 水平。在 TNF-α 刺激的细胞中,ECTV 降低了细胞凋亡蛋白 2 (cIAP2) 细胞抑制剂的水平,而在 LTα 1 β 2 刺激的细胞中,ECTV 降低了 TNF 受体相关因子 3 (TRAF3) 的水平。RT-qPCR 分析显示 ECTV 上调 RELB 、 NFKB2 和 CHUK 表达。病毒感染还增加了 TNFAIP3 和 OTUD7B 的表达,这两种基因编码非经典 NF-κB 信号传导的调节因子。此外,受感染的细胞表现出选定的 RelB 响应基因的表达增加,包括 FBRS 、 CCR10 和 TNFRSF6B。总之,这些发现表明 ECTV 在体外调节与上皮细胞中非经典 NF-κB 信号传导相关的成分,但没有组成型通路激活的证据。

analysis_zh.methods: 研究人员采用荧光显微镜和免疫印迹分析来评估 NF-κB 亚基的核积累,并使用 RT-qPCR 来测量与非经典 NF-κB 信号传导相关的基因表达水平。
analysis_zh.main_results: ECTV 减少 LIGHT 和 LTα 1 β 2 诱导的 RelB 和 p52 核积累,增加全细胞 RelB 和 NF-κB2/p100 水平,并上调 RELB、NFKB2 和 CHUK 表达。它还增加了 TNFAIP3 和 OTUD7B 的表达并选择了 RelB 响应基因。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,ECTV 调节上皮细胞中的非经典 NF-κB 信号传导成分,而无需激活组成型通路,这突显了一种新的免疫逃避机制。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果有助于了解 猴痘病毒 如何操纵 宿主 免疫途径,这可以为未来关于病毒 发病机制 和潜在治疗靶点的研究提供信息。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于体外模型,可能无法完全代表体内动力学,并且证据仅基于抽象数据,导致可信度评估适中。

title: Climate Change, Ecosystem Loss, and Emerging Infectious Diseases in Nigeria
abstract: Climate change and ecosystem degradation can affect infectious-disease hazards, human exposure and the recognition of outbreaks, but the direction and strength of those influences differ among pathogens. Nigeria provides a pertinent setting because reservoir-associated infections, mosquito-borne diseases, waterborne outbreaks and climatically sensitive respiratory infections occur across contrasting ecological zones and unequal healthcare environments. This critical narrative review evaluates literature on climatic variability, land-use change, biodiversity, transmission ecology and disease surveillance, giving priority to Nigerian empirical work and using regional or global studies to clarify mechanisms rather than substitute for local evidence. The strongest environment-linked Nigerian analyses concern Lassa fever, whose geographical incidence correlates with climate, land use and socioeconomic factors, although retrospective prediction does not establish prospective forecast utility. Rodent field studies show that seasonal host abundance and viral detection do not necessarily move together. Dengue investigations identify under-recognised febrile illness and competent mosquito habitats, but antibody, vector and molecular results have different inferential meanings. Yellow fever patterns are inseparable from immunity and surveillance selection. For cholera, floods and climatic anomalies interact with water-system failures, displacement and sanitation disadvantage; direct attribution to ecosystem loss remains limited. Meningitis and mpox further illustrate the danger of extending one ecological mechanism across fundamentally different transmission systems. Persistent limitations include spatial aggregation, incomplete diagnostic denominators, heterogeneous environmental measurements and scarce longitudinal linkage of ecosystem disturbance, infected hosts and confirmed human infection. The synthesis argues for pathogen-specific One Health monitoring, prospective ecological–clinical cohorts, out-of-sample validation of warnings and controlled evaluation of water, vector and household interventions. Climate adaptation and ecosystem protection offer important opportunities, but infectious-disease benefits should be demonstrated rather than presumed.
journal: Asian Journal of Research in Infectious Diseases

analysis.scope_and_question: The review examines the relationship between climate change, ecosystem loss, and emerging infectious diseases, with a focus on the Mpox virus. It explores how environmental changes influence the transmission dynamics, host abundance, and disease recognition of the Mpox virus, particularly in the context of Nigeria's diverse ecological zones and healthcare systems.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a critical narrative synthesis of literature on climatic variability, land-use change, biodiversity, transmission ecology, and disease surveillance. It prioritizes Nigerian empirical studies and uses regional or global research to clarify mechanisms, while emphasizing the need for local evidence. The review does not report on meta-analysis or pooled estimates but instead focuses on qualitative synthesis.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review highlights that Mpox virus transmission is influenced by ecological and climatic factors, but the evidence is limited and heterogeneous. It underscores the importance of pathogen-specific One Health monitoring and the need for prospective ecological–clinical cohorts to better understand the interplay between environmental changes and Mpox outbreaks.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: There is limited direct evidence linking ecosystem loss to Mpox outbreaks, and the review notes that findings from related viruses like variola virus or smallpox cannot be directly applied to Mpox. Additionally, the review identifies gaps in longitudinal studies that link ecosystem disturbance, infected hosts, and confirmed human infections.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review recommends out-of-sample validation of ecological warnings, controlled evaluation of water, vector, and household interventions, and the development of prospective ecological–clinical cohorts to improve understanding of Mpox transmission dynamics in relation to environmental changes.

analysis.summary_en: This review explores the impact of climate change and ecosystem loss on Mpox virus transmission in Nigeria. It emphasizes the need for pathogen-specific One Health monitoring and highlights the limitations of current evidence, which is often indirect or based on related viruses. The review calls for more rigorous studies to link environmental changes with Mpox outbreaks and suggests actionable research priorities, including prospective ecological–clinical cohorts and controlled interventions. While the evidence is heterogeneous and limited, the review underscores the importance of demonstrating infectious-disease benefits through climate adaptation and ecosystem protection.

abstract_zh: 气候变化和生态系统退化会影响传染病危害、人类接触和对 暴发 的识别,但这些影响的方向和强度因病原体而异。尼日利亚提供了一个相关的环境,因为与 储存宿主 相关的感染、蚊媒疾病、水传播的 暴发 和气候敏感的呼吸道感染发生在截然不同的生态区和不平等的医疗环境中。这篇批判性叙述性评论评估了有关气候变化、土地利用变化、生物多样性、传播 生态和疾病 监测 的文献,优先考虑尼日利亚的实证工作,并利用区域或全球研究来阐明机制,而不是替代当地证据。尼日利亚与环境相关的最强分析涉及拉沙热,其地理 发病率 与气候、土地利用和社会经济因素相关,尽管回顾性预测并未建立前瞻性预测效用。啮齿动物实地研究表明,季节性 宿主 丰度和病毒检测不一定会同步变化。登革热调查发现了未被充分认识的发热性疾病和适宜的蚊子栖息地,但抗体、媒介 和分子结果具有不同的推论意义。黄热病模式与免疫和监测选择密不可分。对于霍乱,洪水和气候异常与供水系统故障、流离失所和卫生条件劣势相互作用;生态系统损失的直接归因仍然有限。脑膜炎和 猴痘 进一步说明了将一种生态机制扩展到根本不同的 传播 系统的危险。持续存在的局限性包括空间聚集、不完整的诊断分母、异质环境测量以及生态系统扰动、受感染的 宿主 和已确诊的人类感染的纵向联系稀缺。该综合报告主张针对病原体的 One Health 监测、前瞻性生态临床 队列研究、警告的样本外验证以及水的控制评估、媒介 和家庭干预措施。气候适应和生态系统保护提供了重要的机会,但传染病的好处应该被证明而不是假设。

title: Finger-actuated microfluidic device for point-of-care circulating cell-free nucleic acid extraction.
abstract: Timely and accurate nucleic acid extraction is a critical bottleneck in point-of-care (POC) molecular diagnostics, particularly for low-abundance cell-free nucleic acids (DNA, RNA, miRNA) in plasma. We present a fully finger-actuated microfluidic device for power-free, pipette-free, nucleic acid extraction. The prototype device integrates finger-actuated valves, pump and blister reagent storage, enabling a complete, intuitive, "sample-to-eluate" workflow, including lysis, binding, washing and elution via manual actuation in approximately 35 minutes. The device operation was benchmarked against a commercial magnetic bead-based manual benchtop and an automated robotic workflow. In DNA-spiked aqueous samples (5-20 ng mL-1), the device demonstrated recoveries of 84.6%, against 90.7% on the bench. Optimisation of magnetic bead volume identified 50 μL as the threshold for maximal recovery while minimising reagent consumption. Recovery from human pooled plasma samples were found to be on average 18, 62, and 552% higher than that obtained with the control bench extraction on initial sample volumes of 100, 75 and 50 μL, respectively. Coefficient of variation (CV%) for all techniques remained within reported laboratory ranges (20-80%). The device's clinical utility was piloted using patient samples positive for cytomegalovirus (CMV), monkeypox virus (MPXV) or chikungunya (CHIKV). The device achieved successful qPCR amplification for all targets, with viral DNA Cq values within as little as 0.3 cycles of the standard protocol. This instrument-free, manual circulating nucleic acid extraction tool could help bridge the gap between lateral flow based nucleic acid amplification technologies and real-world decentralised diagnostics, offering a scalable solution for infectious disease management in resource-limited settings.

title: From Sex-Specific Medicine to Xenocortication: A Triangulated Research Brief on Current Frontiers in Medicine and Biology — A Research Brief on Frontier Progress, October 2026
abstract: This research brief triangulates two current issues of leading international journals against the review literature that anticipated them. It first summarizes seven articles—three original studies and four reviews—from a themed issue of a leading international science journal (Vol. 6819) devoted to sex-specific and women's health, spanning metabolism, cancer, osteoarthritis, maternal physiology, sex chromosomes, menopause and chronic pain. It then reviews seven original studies from a companion international research issue (Vol. 8135) covering human-mouse xenocortication, sleep-promoting cortical circuits, mTORC1-linked longevity, tumour-draining lymph-node checkpoints, extrachromosomal DNA maintenance and the monkeypox virus replisome. Finally, it reads these fourteen front-line studies against eleven syntheses published in 2023—on proteostasis in retinal ageing, excitotoxicity and neural repair, checkpoint cytology, single-cell annotation, ocular imaging, comparative pharmacology and vaccine hesitancy—showing how each anticipated a theme now at the frontier.

elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述综合了来自国际领先科学期刊(Vol.)两期主题的 14 项前沿研究,包括 7 项原创研究和 7 篇综述,还引用了 2023 年发表的 11 项综合研究,涵盖视网膜衰老中的蛋白质稳态、兴奋性毒性、神经修复和 疫苗 犹豫等主题,以展示他们如何预测当前的研究主题。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 该综述强调,猴痘病毒及其进化枝(I 和 II)对于了解 猴痘 疾病至关重要。它强调了研究病毒生物学(包括其复制体)及其在疾病进展中的作用的重要性。该评论还指出,这些研究预测了目前处于前沿的主题,例如病毒与 宿主 因素之间的相互作用。

title: Recomendaciones para el abordaje de infecciones de transmisión sexual en niños, niñas y adolescentes víctimas de violencia sexual
abstract: La violencia sexual en niños, niñas y adolescentes (NNA) constituye un grave problema de salud pública, con consecuencias físicas, psicológicas y sociales a corto y largo plazo. Dentro de sus complicaciones médicas, las infecciones de transmisión sexual (ITS) representan un desafío diagnóstico, terapéutico y médico-legal, particularmente en la población pediátrica. En Chile, las guías existentes han sido desarrolladas para la población adulta y no abordan de forma integral el manejo de ITS en NNA víctimas de violencia sexual (VVS). Este documento, elaborado por el Comité de VIH Pediátrico de la Sociedad Chilena de Pediatría, tiene como objetivo establecer recomendaciones actualizadas para el diagnóstico, profilaxis, tratamiento y seguimiento de ITS en NNA víctimas de violencia sexual, considerando la mejor evidencia científica disponible, realidad epidemiológica, normativa y farmacológica nacional. La metodología incluyó revisión crítica de literatura internacional y nacional, guías clínicas vigentes y consenso de expertos. Se abordan las principales ITS relevantes en este contexto –gonorrea, clamidiasis, tricomoniasis, sífilis, VIH/SIDA, hepatitis A, B y C, herpes simple, virus del papiloma humano y Mpox–, detallando indicaciones de toma de muestras, períodos ventana, esquemas terapéuticos, profilaxis post exposición, vacunación y seguimiento serológico. Estas recomendaciones buscan estandarizar el abordaje infectológico de NNA VVS en Chile, optimizando la pesquisa precoz, el tratamiento oportuno y las estrategias preventivas, en concordancia con la normativa nacional vigente.

Dentro de sus complicaciones médicas, las infecciones de transmisión sexual (ITS) representan un desafío diagnóstico, terapéutico y médico-legal, particularmente en la población pediátrica. En Chile, las guías existentes han sido desarrolladas para la población adulta y no abordan de forma integral el manejo de ITS en NNA víctimas de violencia sexual (VVS). Este documento, elaborado por el Comité de VIH Pediátrico de la Sociedad Chilena de Pediatría, tiene como objetivo establecer recomendaciones actualizadas para el diagnóstico, profilaxis, tratamiento y seguimiento de ITS en NNA víctimas de violencia sexual, considerando la mejor evidencia científica disponible, realidad epidemiológica, normativa y farmacológica nacional. La metodología incluyó revisión crítica de literatura internacional y nacional, guías clínicas vigentes y consenso de expertos. Se abordan las principales ITS relevantes en este contexto –gonorrea, clamidiasis, tricomoniasis, sífilis, VIH/SIDA, hepatitis A, B y C, herpes simple, virus del papiloma humano y Mpox–, detallando indicaciones de toma de muestras, períodos ventana, esquemas terapéuticos, profilaxis post exposición, vacunación y seguimiento serológico. Estas recomendaciones buscan estandarizar el abordaje infectológico de NNA VVS en Chile, optimizando la pesquisa precoz, el tratamiento oportuno y las estrategias preventivas, en concordancia con la normativa nacional vigente.

analysis.summary_en: This study addresses the need for updated guidelines on the diagnosis, prevention, treatment, and follow-up of sexually transmitted infections (STIs) in children, adolescents, and victims of sexual violence. The research question focuses on the challenges of managing STIs in this vulnerable population, particularly in the context of sexual violence. The study design is based on a critical review of existing literature, clinical guidelines, and expert consensus. The methods involved analyzing the most relevant STIs, including mpox, and detailing sampling protocols, window periods, therapeutic schemes, post-exposure prophylaxis, vaccination, and serological follow-up. The main results include the establishment of comprehensive recommendations for the management of STIs in children and adolescents affected by sexual violence. The authors interpret these findings as a means to standardize the infectious approach in this population, aligning with national regulations. The scientific and public health significance lies in the potential to improve early detection, timely treatment, and preventive strategies in Chile. However, the evidence strength is moderate due to the reliance on literature review and expert consensus rather than original studies or statistical data.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 儿童、儿童和青少年的性暴力构成了公共健康、暴力、精神和社会问题的严重问题。这是一份关于性传播感染和大众感染的实际建议的文件。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究室对国际和国内文学批评进行了修订,以临床实践和专家共识为指导。在儿童、儿童和性暴力受害者青少年中,应考虑 ITS 的主要问题,考虑可靠的科学证据、流行病学的现实和国家规范。
elements_zh.methods: 我们对 ITS 相关原理进行了分析,包括在上下文中详细说明了学生、期间、治疗、暴露后的轮廓、真空和血清学的相关指示。
elements_zh.main_results: Se abordaron las primes ITS relatedes en este contexto –淋病、衣原体病、滴虫病、sífilis、VIH/SIDA、甲型、乙型和丙型肝炎、单纯疱疹、人乳头瘤病毒和猴痘–、detallando indicaciones de toma de muestras、períodos ventana、esquemas terapéuticos、profilaxis后期展示、真空和血清学研究。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 建议对智利儿童、儿童和青少年性暴力受害者采取预防感染措施,优化预防措施、机会和预防策略,并与国家规范保持一致。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 建议在儿童、儿童和青少年性暴力受害人、儿童和青少年的临床实践中提供信息,并在智利背景下进行预防性治疗和实施预防策略。

title: Safety and immunogenicity of a first-generation modified vaccinia virus Ankara-vectored SARS-CoV-2 vaccine candidate with mRNA-based booster vaccination: A phase 1 trial
abstract: The rapid development of effective COVID-19 vaccines was enabled by the parallel assessment of multiple candidates early in the pandemic, including candidates based on the Modified Vaccinia virus Ankara (MVA) vector platform. This Phase 1 trial (NCT04569383) evaluated the MVA-based vaccine candidate MVA-SARS-2-S, expressing the full-length native SARS-CoV-2 spike glycoprotein (Wuhan-HU-1). Between October 2020 and May 2021, 30 healthy, SARS-CoV-2–naive adults received two doses of either 107 or 108 international units (IU) of MVA-SARS-2-S 28 days apart, with 6-month follow-up. A subgroup (n = 12) received two BNT162b2 booster vaccinations. Safety and reactogenicity were primary objectives; secondary and exploratory objectives included S1 seroconversion rates, S-domain-specific antibodies, SARS-CoV-2-neutralizing antibodies, and spike-specific T cell responses. MVA-SARS-2-S demonstrated a good safety profile. No severe or serious adverse events occurred. Immunogenicity was poor: S1-specific seroconversion occurred in 0/15 (107 IU group) and 3/15 (108 IU group) participants. Binding antibodies were predominantly directed against the S2 subunit, with peak median anti-S2 fold changes of 6.0 and 5.2 in the 107 IU and 108 IU groups, respectively. Neutralizing antibodies were detected in one participant (108 IU group); spike-specific T cell responses were observed in 5/15 (107 IU group) and 2/13 (108 IU group) participants. Heterologous BNT162b2 vaccination induced S1 seroconversion and detectable neutralizing antibody and T cell responses in all boosted participants, without safety concerns. In conclusion, while MVA-SARS-2-S was well tolerated and did not adversely affect subsequent BNT162b2 boosting, the vaccine candidate elicited insufficient immunogenicity, underscoring the need for optimized antigen design.
